# warpbuild Provider

Manage WarpBuild runner infrastructure via the [automation API](https://www.warpbuild.com/docs/ci/api-keys/automation).

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "warpbuild" {
  # API key with the `ci` scope; may also be set via WARPBUILD_API_KEY.
  # api_key = "wkey-..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_endpoint` (String) WarpBuild API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.warpbuild.com/api/v1`. May also be set via the `WARPBUILD_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) WarpBuild API key with the `ci` scope. May also be set via the `WARPBUILD_API_KEY` environment variable.
